    Technology overview

    The architecture behind the trust.

    Truecopy is a horizontal trust layer between your systems of record and the people who make decisions — built on cryptography, policy-as-code, and a CCA-licensed signing core.

    Architecture diagram To be provided by client

    Cryptography & key management

    AES-256 at rest and in transit, HSM-backed keys, and customer-managed key options.

    CCA-licensed signing core

    A Government of India CCA-licensed e-sign authority underpins Aadhaar eSign, DSC, and corporate signatures.

    Policy-as-code engine

    Authorization rules, value bands, jurisdiction, and segregation-of-duties expressed as code, evaluated in real time.

    Deployable anywhere

    Kubernetes-based and horizontally scalable. Run on public, private, on-prem, or air-gapped — same code.

    APIs, webhooks & SDKs

    Surfaced as REST APIs and webhooks, with SDKs in six languages and 200+ enterprise connectors.

    Immutable evidence ledger

    An append-only, hash-chained ledger with RFC-3161 timestamping makes every event reproducible.
